name: labs/labjack__labjackpython
title: LabJack U3 USB DAQ (LabJackPython U3)
intro: LabJack U3 USB DAQ (LabJackPython U3), adapted from labjack/labjackpython. It reads `analog_input_0`, `internal_temperature`, `dio_states` and `measure_voltage`; sets `fio_analog` and `eio_analog`; runs `set_digital_output` and `reset_device`. `set_digital_output`: drive one U3 digital I/O line high or low; the line is also set to output. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
